appraisal_events.evidence: Mme de Luxembourg ... et Mme de Villeparisis parurent toujours, quand la première venait chercher la seconde pour se promener en voiture, deux drôlesses de l'espèce de celles dont on se gare difficilement dans les villes d'eaux.
appraisal_events.explanation: The same bourgeois misreading that brands the princesse de Luxembourg a demimondaine extends explicitly to Mme de Villeparisis, who is named alongside her as one of the 'deux drôlesses'; the narrator frames this as a durable, structural misunderstanding rather than an endorsed judgment.

status_effects.explanation: In the bourgeois perception the passage reports, she is locally mistaken for a disreputable woman, lowering her apparent standing despite her real rank, though the narrator's broader commentary treats this as a systematic bourgeois error rather than a deserved verdict.
